free_choice_probabilities.note: Probabilities are measured only when the commitment expires. Initial weights are queried on the same latest-policy observations/context, not separate initial-policy trajectories.

provenance.limitations: Seeded starts and policy RNG do not guarantee bitwise RocketSim trajectories. Automatic demolition respawns use native randomness without an exposed global seed. Resume restores policy/optimizer/timesteps, not a mid-rollout physics/RNG snapshot. Repeat independent seeds and training seeds before claiming an improvement.

Padding permutations have the same distribution, not the same C++ random stream. This is exploratory, not a promotion test or proof of native strength.
